kill_switch.description: true = block every cloud-capable AI call (S2 cloud fallback, S3, S4 cloud). Device and rules paths keep working.

routing_policy.description: Routing by payload class. Client merges with a hard floor: S0/S1 can never be loosened.

adversary_model.description: Pass A/B cloud model (exact id, never -latest).

adversary_thinking_level.description: LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH. MINIMAL is a 400 on gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-4-*.

explain_cloud_model.description: S2 explainer / S4 cloud fallback model.

prompt_versions.description: Selects among prompt versions BUNDLED in the app. Prompt text never comes from Remote Config.

grounding_enabled.description: Run pass A (Search-grounded notes). false = pass B only (cut order step 4).

daily_adversary_cap.description: Max attack runs (A+B pair = 1) per install per UTC day. Keep project-wide grounded queries < 1,500/day.

bands_m.description: Distance band upper bounds in metres. city/country are placeholders, not from the spec.

clue_types.description: Display filter only; must be a subset of enums.v1.json (unknown values dropped).

auto_mask_types.description: Nano pre-screen clue types masked automatically when severity is high (faces, vault hits and regex hits are always masked).

strict_mode_default.description: Strict mode masks every flagged clue before the cloud sees anything.

fuzzy_threshold.description: Normalised Levenshtein similarity for OCR-to-vault matches (0..1).

mask_pad_ratio.description: Mask padding as a fraction of the box size.

cloud_image_max_px.description: Longest side of the redacted JPEG sent to the cloud.

nano_image_max_px.description: Longest side of the JPEG given to Gemini Nano.

judge_cached_fallback.description: If the live adversary is unavailable in Judge Mode, replay the recorded pass-B JSON for the synthetic sample (badge CACHED).

extension_enabled.description: Stretch: accept files from the Chrome extension.

adversary_seed.description: UNVERIFIED experiment: if non-zero, cast-send generationConfig.seed. 0 = do not send.
